desc: 靛蓝柑橘粉彩四色青春体系，空浮窗与留白图标卡承载智能续航叙事
leaf: 多彩铝壳轻薄学生笔记本电脑
name: 四色青春版轻薄笔记本款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代靛蓝机身与窄边框屏比例。
用四台半开机身左右对称扇形展开的色阵，一秒展示全部可选配色。
把柑橘色机身放进黄昏球馆看台，写进学生运动员的间隙日常。
用午后教室课桌上的背影与侧影学习瞬间，完成学生购机的自我代入。
用近黑屏场中一枚空白助手浮窗，把智能写作卖点留成可替换版式。
用俯视打字瞬间加三枚留白利益卡，把续航屏幕智能三卖点排成一行。
收口信任，用整机与充电配件的三格留白清单交代盒内含量。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless snow-white #FAFAFB field for packshot, fan and typing frames with one soft indigo tint #EEF0F6 variant, warm gym dusk and sunlit classroom interiors confined to the two lifestyle frames, one near-black display well reserved for the screen macro, pale card grid for the inventory close
style.direction: youthful candy-anodized laptop commerce, campus light and pastel metal
style.iconSystem: thin two-tone line glyphs (battery, sun, spark flower) above blank caption rails, one empty floating assistant card with blank option chips, no interface text, no brand marks
style.lightingSystem: bright friendly daylight near 6200K, clean even key with soft modelling on pastel metal, warm directional sun in the gym frame, window-lit classroom glow, one saturated glow from the screen well, never clinical cold
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent youthful candy-anodized laptop ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of indigo shell #47536E, citrus yellow #D9DE7E, blush pink #E8BCC4 and snow white field #FAFAFB with one soft indigo tint #EEF0F6; bright friendly daylight near 6200K, clean even key with soft modelling on pastel metal, warm directional sun in the gym frame, window glow in the classroom frame and one saturated screen-well light; matte anodized candy aluminium, pale maple surfaces only in lifestyle, smooth white cards and a glass screen well, no marble, no dark studio floors; one rounded friendly sans kept as empty placeholder rails; thin two-tone glyphs and one blank floating assistant card; blank dark glass screens and unmarked lids; no color palette changes, no readable interface text, no brand logos, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable interface or assistant text
no brand logos on lid or screen
style.presentationRules: screens are always blank dark glass or a plain gradient wash with no interface, lids carry no logo, people are generic students cropped or softened, the four colourways stay matte pastel with matched key wells
style.surfaceSystem: matte anodized aluminium in four candy tints, pale maple desk and bleacher wood confined to lifestyle frames, smooth white card boards, glass screen well, no marble, no dark studio floors
style.typography: one rounded friendly sans in ink #2A2E38, every headline, caption, pill and stat slot kept as an empty placeholder
